name: Paletas El Sol
facts: Paletas El Sol is a sample ice cream truck; each real truck sets its own menu, prices and deals.
Join with your first name and get 10 free points.
The app rings your phone when the truck is close.
Your house pin is saved only on your phone; the truck never sees your address.
You can pick an alert distance of 0.15, 0.25 or 0.5 mi.
Alerts: one per truck visit; Quiet after 8 PM option.
Visit card: 5 visits = a treat on us (10% off or an extra scoop free).
Check in by scanning the QR on the truck: one check-in per truck visit.
Alerts on = +5 bonus points every visit.
The driver scans your code at the window; a purchase earns +10 points.
Rewards: 50¢ off, $1 off, free chili cheese chips, free paleta.
Pay at the window: cash, card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
Menu: ice cream, paletas, drinks, candy and toys.
Deals: Buy 2 get the 3rd half off; Kid Combo $1.50 off; Family Pack $5 off.
Toy deal on Fridays: 3rd toy free.
The app is in English and Spanish.
suggested: How do I get alerts when the truck is close?
How does the 5 visit card work?

qa.q: What is this app?
qa.a: It's the truck alerts app for Paletas El Sol. It shows the truck coming on a live map, rings your phone when it's close, and has the menu, deals, points and rewards.

qa.q: Is Paletas El Sol a real truck?
qa.a: Paletas El Sol is a sample truck used to show how the app works. Every truck sets its own menu, prices and deals.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: I don't have set hours for the truck. The app shows where the truck is and how many minutes away it is, so check the map or ask staff.

qa.q: Where is the truck right now?
qa.a: Open the app and look at the live map. It shows the truck driving toward your pin with a countdown like 'Arriving in ~10 min'.

qa.q: How do I know how long until the truck gets here?
qa.a: The app shows the minutes and miles away, for example '~10 min · 1.2 mi'. It counts down as the truck gets closer.

qa.q: What's the address?
qa.a: A truck moves around, so there's no fixed address in the app. Watch the live map, or ask staff where the truck will be.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking info. The truck comes to your street, so you can usually just walk out to it.

qa.q: What's the phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to give you. Please ask the driver or staff at the truck window.

qa.q: How do I join?
qa.a: Type your first name in Step 1 and tap 'Join + get 10 free points'. It only takes about 10 seconds.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No. Joining gives you 10 free points.

qa.q: What do I need to sign up?
qa.a: Just your first name.

qa.q: How do I get alerts when the truck is close?
qa.a: Join, share your street, then turn on alerts. We'll ring your phone when the truck is near.

qa.q: How do I share my street?
qa.a: In Step 2 tap 'Allow location' or tap 'Type my street' and enter your street and city.

qa.q: Why do you need my location?
qa.a: Only to know which street to ring when the truck is close. We don't follow you around, and you can turn it off any time.

qa.q: Does the truck see my address?
qa.a: No. Your house pin is saved only on your phone and the truck never sees your address.

qa.q: What if I don't want to share my location?
qa.a: No problem. You can type your street instead of allowing location.

qa.q: How do I turn on alerts on iPhone?
qa.a: Tap Share (the square with the arrow), then Add to Home Screen. Open the app from your Home Screen and allow notifications. That's Apple's rule for alerts.

qa.q: How do I turn on alerts on Android?
qa.a: Just tap 'Allow' when it asks.

qa.q: How do I install the app?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there. On Android, tap Allow when it asks for alerts.

qa.q: How close does the truck have to be before it rings me?
qa.a: You choose: 0.15 mi, 0.25 mi or 0.5 mi in Settings.

qa.q: How many alerts will I get?
qa.a: One alert per truck visit.

qa.q: Can I stop alerts at night?
qa.a: Yes. Turn on 'Quiet after 8 PM' in Settings.

qa.q: Can I turn off the jingle sound?
qa.a: Yes. Switch off 'Play the jingle' in Settings.

qa.q: Can I hear the jingle?
qa.a: Yes. Tap 'Test the alert' to hear the jingle and see how the alert looks.

qa.q: Can I turn alerts off?
qa.a: Yes, any time, with the 'Alerts on' switch in Settings. Note that you miss the +5 bonus points per visit while they're off.

qa.q: What does 'I'm coming' do?
qa.a: When the alert rings, tap 'I'm coming!' and the driver sees that 1 person is on the way. It also takes you to the menu.

qa.q: What does Silence do?
qa.a: It stops the ringing alert.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You get 10 points when you join, +10 when the driver scans your code at the window after a purchase, and +5 bonus for each truck check-in with alerts on.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit?
qa.a: +5 bonus points each time you check in at the truck with alerts on. Buying also earns +10 when the driver scans your code.

qa.q: How many points per dollar?
qa.a: There's no per-dollar rate. A purchase earns +10 points when the driver scans your code.

qa.q: How many points do I get for joining?
qa.a: 10 free points.

qa.q: What is the alerts bonus?
qa.a: Keep alerts on and you get +5 bonus points every visit. Turn alerts off and you miss them.

qa.q: How do I get points for a purchase?
qa.a: Show your code to the driver at the window. When the driver scans it you get +10 points.

qa.q: Where do I see my points?
qa.a: In the 'Points + rewards' section. It shows your total and how many more you need for the next reward.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 50¢ off, $1 off, a free chili cheese chips, or a free paleta. You can also earn a treat from the visit card.

qa.q: How many points does each reward cost?
qa.a: Each reward shows its point cost right next to it in the app. I don't have the exact numbers here, so check the Points + rewards list.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap 'Use' next to a reward you have enough points for. A code appears. Show it to the driver.

qa.q: Why can't I tap Use on a reward?
qa.a: You don't have enough points for it yet. The app shows how many more points you need for the next one.

qa.q: Do my points get used when I redeem?
qa.a: Yes, the reward's point cost comes off your total when you tap Use.

qa.q: Is there a free paleta reward?
qa.a: Yes, 'Free paleta' is one of the rewards. Check the app for its point cost.

qa.q: Is there a free chili cheese chips reward?
qa.a: Yes, 'Free chili cheese chips' is a reward. Its point cost is shown in the app.

qa.q: What is the visit card?
qa.a: It's a punch card: 5 visits equals a treat on us. Check in at the truck each visit to fill it.

qa.q: How do I check in at the truck?
qa.a: Scan the QR code on the truck. You get one check-in per truck visit.

qa.q: Can I check in more than once per visit?
qa.a: No. It's one check-in per truck visit.

qa.q: What do I get on my 5th visit?
qa.a: Your pick of a treat: 10% off or an extra scoop free.

qa.q: What happens after I pick my treat?
qa.a: You get a code to show the driver, and your visit card starts over.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have any levels or tiers in the app. You just collect points and visits for rewards.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have a birthday club listed. Ask the driver if there's a birthday treat.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: I don't have a referral program listed. Ask the driver or staff.

qa.q: Are there games?
qa.a: I don't see any games in this app. It has truck alerts, the menu and deals, points and the visit card.

qa.q: Are there weekly contests or prizes?
qa.a: I don't have any weekly contests listed. Ask staff if anything is running.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Ice cream, paletas, drinks, candy and toys. Tap + to build your order and deals apply by themselves.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Examples on the sample menu: big iced tea can (23 oz), sports drink, and juice pouch.

qa.q: How much is a drink?
qa.a: Sample prices: big iced tea can $2.00, sports drink $2.50, juice pouch $1.50. Every truck sets its own prices.

qa.q: What deals are on today?
qa.a: Buy 2 get the 3rd half off, Kid Combo, Family Pack, plus Happy Hour 3-4 PM and a toy deal on Fridays. See 'Today's deals' in the app.

qa.q: How does Buy 2, get the 3rd half off work?
qa.a: On any ice cream bars, every 3rd one (the cheapest) is half price.

qa.q: What is the Kid Combo?
qa.a: $1.50 off when you get any ice cream, any drink and any candy.

qa.q: What is the Family Pack?
qa.a: $5 off when you get 4 ice creams and 4 drinks.

qa.q: When is Happy Hour?
qa.a: 3 to 4 PM. Every fruit and cream paleta is $1 off.

qa.q: What is the Friday toy deal?
qa.a: On Fridays, the 3rd toy is free.

qa.q: Do I have to enter a coupon for deals?
qa.a: No. Deals apply by themselves when you add items to your order.

qa.q: Can I order ahead in the app?
qa.a: You can build your order in the app and tap 'Show this to the driver'. Nothing is sent or paid in the app. You order and pay at the truck window.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay at the window with cash, card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: No. The app doesn't take payment. You pay the driver at the window.

qa.q: What does 'Show this to the driver' do?
qa.a: It shows your order and a code. The driver scans your code at the window, and you get +10 points.

qa.q: Can I clear my order?
qa.a: Yes. Open your order and tap 'Clear order'.

qa.q: Can I hear the deals read aloud?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the button to read today's deals out loud.

qa.q: Is the app in Spanish?
qa.a: Yes. Switch between English and Español at the top of the app.

qa.q: What does the live map show?
qa.a: Your house pin and the truck driving toward you on real streets, with the time and distance left.

qa.q: What is the Recenter button?
qa.a: It brings the map back to show both your pin and the truck.

qa.q: Is my info sold?
qa.a: No. Your info is never sold.

qa.q: How do I delete my info?
qa.a: Tap 'Leave + delete my info' in Settings. It removes your info from your phone.

qa.q: Do I need a login or password?
qa.a: No. You just enter your first name to join.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: I don't have a kids mode. The menu does have a Kid Combo deal.

qa.q: Do you have a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have a wallet card. You can add the app to your Home Screen instead.

qa.q: Can I order from a table or QR code?
qa.a: There are no tables on a truck. The QR code on the truck is for checking in and earning visits.

qa.q: Do you have sports or trivia features?
qa.a: No. This app is about the truck, menu, points and visit card.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask the driver at the truck window. They can scan your code and answer questions.

qa.q: What if the truck already left?
qa.a: The app shows that the truck left and that it will be back soon. You'll get another alert on its next pass.

qa.q: Why didn't I get an alert?
qa.a: Check that alerts are on, you shared your street, and your alert distance isn't too small. On iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen and allow notifications. Quiet after 8 PM may also hold alerts at night.
